text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Stack: frozen model with the 14-day correction and spread factor 1.15. Every other arm has the spread factor and, unless named, no correction. Control member of the ECMWF ensemble only, 13 Primary substations, 274 daily forecast runs from July 2023 to March 2024 (fold B). Scores are control-only and are not comparable with 51-member scores. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole 4-week blocks of forecast start. Zero: same score.'
text.tspan: Stack: frozen model with the 14-day correction and spread factor 1.15. Every other arm has
the spread factor and, unless named, no correction. Control member of the ECMWF ensemble
only, 13 Primary substations, 274 daily forecast runs from July 2023 to March 2024 (fold B).
Scores are control-only and are not comparable with 51-member scores.
Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole 4-week blocks of forecast start. Zero:
